text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"The blue bird spreads its glass wings 
into the sky."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "Higher, higher, higher into the sky."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: "—And so,"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
" 'Reaching the rainbow's very start, 
light bathing glass wings, bathing the 
body' "

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"To everyone, a rainbow was delivered, to 
each and every one, a sparkling rainbow."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"And so, they all lived happily, happily 
ever after."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(I just wanted... to bring them happiness, 
and make them smile.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Forever. ...Forever—!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"First place in the Takamatsunomiya Kinen 
is K.S. Miracle! It's K.S. Miracle!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle brilliantly conquers the 
blitzkrieg battle!! A new sprint champion 
is born right here, right now!
(WOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, everyone's... watching. They're 
smiling.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Mom. Dad. The doctor. The nurses. Ahaha, 
the kids are here too.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone, every single one of them... is 
smiling.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!!

K.S. Miracle bowed deeply, and remained 
that way, not raising his head for a long, 
long time.

Gratitude for everything up until now. 
Repaying the precious people in my life.

It was an exceptionally polite bow, filled 
with a flood of deep emotions.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san. ...That was splendid.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ruby...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like this one's my win.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The sheer frustration of it... feels 
as though it's burning my very soul.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
All the more reason to, one day without 
fail, avenge this defeat.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
In the races ahead. Somewhere out there in 
our future, we'll meet again.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
With the title of fastest on the line. 
Let's race again, Ruby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —By all means.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...I'm back, Trainer.

"And so, K.S. Miracle safely returned to 
my side. With light footsteps and head 
held high."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Trainer?

"Once I said it out loud, it was over. I 
couldn't hold it back. Even though I 
wanted to look at her clearly, her figure 
blurred more and more through my tears."

The time I pushed her too hard. The time 
she couldn't open her eyes. And how, 
despite all that, she stood back up once 
more.

"Her figure as she tore through the turf 
faster than anyone else. Her smile in the 
winner's circle. Overwhelmed with emotion, 
tears welled in my eyes and streamed down 
my cheeks."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: Sorry... Look at me, acting so pathetic...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That's not true. ...You're not pathetic at 
all.

A gently extended hand, her fingertips 
softly wiping away the tears still 
clinging to her eyes.

She cupped my cheeks in both hands just 
like that. The chilly coolness of her 
touch made me acutely aware of how 
feverish my tear-stained cheeks were.

My face is a mess, but I can't look down. 
Our eyes meet. She stares straight at me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Look, it doesn't look unsightly at all.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
She's always reliable, cool, and supports 
me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You gave me this kind of future... You're 
the Trainer I'm so proud of."

Because K.S.Miracle smiles, it only makes 
me tear up more. Even so, I refuse to look 
down any longer.

Looking into each other's eyes, we went 
through cycles of crying and laughing. We 
savored the sheer happiness of being able 
to do just that.

Winning the Takamatsunomiya Kinen. 
Achieving the title of the fastest, which 
she had yearned for so deeply. Having 
accomplished this brilliantly, and so—

The ever-vibrant tale of K.S.Miracle 
stretches even further, beyond the 
horizon.
Anyone home?!
—Continuing ever onward.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahahaha!! I've waited and waited, 
longed for this moment!! Welcome homeッ!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Why are you stammering your answer!? 
Please, have confidence! In a loud voice!! 
Say my name!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"There's no mistaking her! The uniform 
that suits her best of all! That pretty 
little forehead! And the cherry blossom 
with eyes full of vibrant energy!!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is everything!! Proof that I am 
indeed Sakura Bakushin O!! BWAHAHAHAHA!!

The one who boldly volunteered with such 
vigor was... Sakura Bakushin O, currently 
in the Classic Class.

Her incredible speed has already drawn 
considerable attention, sparking rumors 
that she might become the new star of the 
sprint division, but—

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well... What's up, Bakushin O? What do 
you mean, you were "waiting" for us...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowa!! Yes, yes, yes, that's exactly 
right!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I have been waiting right here the entire 
time!! —Ever since returning from Chukyo 
Racecourse, the ENTIRE time!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Chukyo...? Wait, isn't that—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I was watching from the stands, of course. 
Watching your "speed," K.S. Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Did you... choose me—?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A race is—!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Starting all together!! A competition 
where whoever crosses the finish line 
"faster" and quicker than anyone else 
wins!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Stamina, power, heart, and tactics! An 
overwhelmingly dominant speed that 
surpasses and leaves everything in the 
dust!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That is the very essence of racing!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Only the one who commands "speed" is the 
true victor!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And!! I am done forーーー!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
“—I have always been certain that I am the 
fastest, that I am the peerless King of 
Bakushin.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The whole time!! ...Until I watched that 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's my first time!! My very first time!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The first time, the first time... 
...Oooooohhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Why are you faster than me!?!? K.S. 
Miracle-san!!!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O... You really thought of me 
like that...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, exactly!! That's precisely it!! 
...However!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"<color=italic>For now</color>! Yes, let's keep it at <color=italic>for now</color>! I 
will definitely make it happen!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"...Originally, my goal was to conquer all 
races!! I never intended to get so wrapped 
up in sprint races, but—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For now, hi-yaah!! I'll put that on hold 
for later!! ...More importantly!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: K.S.Miracle-san!! Let's race!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"You may be a tiny bit faster than me... 
<color=italic>for now</color>! But mark my words, I will turn 
the tables on you in the future!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The stage is set for autumn, at the 
'Sprinters Stakes'!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With the title of 'Fastest of Our Era' on 
the line! Let's settle this!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ("Fastest of the Era"—)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That is all! And with that!! I must be off 
to train!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin Bakushiiiiin!!

The encounter with Sakura Bakushin O had 
been just like a whirlwind.

However... the interaction with her seemed 
to have brought something significant to 
K.S.Miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The 'Sprinters Stakes' in the fall... Do 
you think it's okay for me to aim for it?

If we are to push forward on the sprint 
path we initially set out on, I would like 
to claim the title of fastest in autumn as 
well as spring.

Besides, it also serves as a revenge match 
for the Classic tier. It was a race I had 
set my sights on from the beginning.
choice_data_list:
Still, that's pretty far in the future, 
so—

text_block_list.text:
First, our major goal is the spring mile 
championship, the Yasuda Kinen, and we 
want to hone her speed leading up to it.

Also, it seems Daiichi Ruby will be 
running in the Milier's Cup and the Keio 
Hai Spring Cup, so it would be good to 
compete against your rival there.
choice_data_list:
For now, let's aim for the Yasuda Kinen, 
shall we?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I look forward to working with 
you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —Shin, Bakushiiin...!

Faint voices could be heard during the 
practice runs. K.S. Miracle seemed deep in 
thought. ...A new chapter was about to 
begin.
